{{Quote|For the Empire!|The command crew to [[Hera Syndulla]]|<ref name="Part Two" />}}
A '''human''' was a command crew of [[Myn Weaver]], who operated on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] as a [[Regional Supervisor]] for the [[New Republic]]. He was secretly an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] loyalist who worked for the [[witch]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] and her [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces|forces]]. When [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Hera Syndulla]] investigated about droids, they attacked them. He was [[Death|killed]] by Ahsoka, when he tried to shoot Hera.<ref name="Part Two" />
